## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`uv run pytest` in `apps/api`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`uv run ruff check .`)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, docs/, or ADR if architecture changed)
- [ ] Migrations included and tested (`alembic upgrade head`) if schema changed
- [ ] Linked issue referenced
